definitions.explanation: The position of attacking rather than defending, in war, sport, or argument; and, by extension, an aggressive campaign such as a sales drive ({売|う}り{込|こ}み{攻勢|こうせい}). The opposite is {守勢|しゅせい}.

examples.japanese: {攻勢|こうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{攻勢|こうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}めた→強める：02296_tsuyomeru⟧。
examples.english: In the second half the other team stepped up its attack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧、⟦{各社|かくしゃ}→各社：11057_kakusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧{攻勢|こうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: With the new products coming out, every company is mounting a fierce advertising push.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {攻勢|こうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go on the offensive
- {攻勢|こうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to mount an offensive
- {攻勢|こうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}める→強める：02296_tsuyomeru⟧: to step up the attack
- ⟦{売|う}り{込|こ}み→売り込み：09341_urikomi⟧{攻勢|こうせい}: a hard sales push

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧: attack — the act itself; {攻勢|こうせい} is the overall stance or campaign
- ⟦{守勢|しゅせい}→守勢：25695_shusei⟧: defensive position — the opposite
